mapper.insert: INSERT INTO okx_orders ( idempotency_key, client_order_id, decision_id, strategy_id, inst_id, action, side, td_mode, order_type, target_currency, requested_size, status, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{idempotencyKey}, #{clientOrderId}, #{decisionId}, #{strategyId}, #{instId}, #{action}, #{side}, #{tdMode}, #{orderType}, #{targetCurrency}, #{requestedSize}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE idempotency_key = VALUES(idempotency_key)
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.idempotency_key, o.client_order_id, o.exchange_order_id, o.decision_id, o.strategy_id, o.inst_id, o.action, o.side, o.td_mode, o.order_type, o.target_currency, o.requested_size, o.status, o.version, o.filled_base_amount, o.average_fill_price, o.fee, o.fee_ccy, o.failure_code, o.failure_message, o.created_at, o.updated_at, o.submitted_at, o.completed_at FROM okx_orders o WHERE o.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT o.id, o.idempotency_key, o.client_order_id, o.exchange_order_id, o.decision_id, o.strategy_id, o.inst_id, o.action, o.side, o.td_mode, o.order_type, o.target_currency, o.requested_size, o.status, o.version, o.filled_base_amount, o.average_fill_price, o.fee, o.fee_ccy, o.failure_code, o.failure_message, o.created_at, o.updated_at, o.submitted_at, o.completed_at FROM okx_orders o WHERE o.inst_id = #{instId} AND o.status IN ( 'SUBMITTING', 'SUBMIT_UNKNOWN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'CANCEL_PENDING' ) ORDER BY o.updated_at ASC, o.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE okx_orders SET exchange_order_id = #{next.exchangeOrderId}, status = #{next.status}, version = #{next.version}, filled_base_amount = #{next.filledBaseAmount}, average_fill_price = #{next.averageFillPrice}, fee = #{next.fee}, fee_ccy = #{next.feeCcy}, failure_code = #{next.failureCode}, failure_message = #{next.failureMessage}, updated_at = #{next.updatedAt}, submitted_at = #{next.submittedAt}, completed_at = #{next.completedAt} WHERE id = #{current.id} AND status = #{current.status} AND version = #{current.version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO okx_order_status_history ( order_id, from_status, to_status, version, reason ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{version}, #{reason} )
